description: Source code for network connectivity monitoring, including classes and functions for checking internet status via curl, managing endpoints, and handling connectivity events within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: EndpointManager
classes.description: Manages connectivity endpoints, including reading from and writing to cache files, and updating endpoint list.

classes.name: DnsResolver
classes.description: Commented out code for DNS resolution and IP conversion (not active in current file).

classes.name: TestConnectivity
classes.description: Performs connectivity tests using curl to determine internet status, including handling captive portals and response code analysis.

classes.name: ConnectivityMonitor
classes.description: Main class for monitoring network connectivity, managing periodic checks, and notifying status changes.

methods.name: getInternetStateString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the internet status enum.

methods.name: EndpointManager::writeEndpointsToFile
methods.description: Writes the list of endpoints to a cache file.

methods.name: EndpointManager::readEndpointsFromFile
methods.description: Reads endpoints from the cache file.

methods.name: EndpointManager::setConnectivityMonitorEndpoints
methods.description: Sets and updates the list of connectivity monitor endpoints.

methods.name: EndpointManager::getConnectivityMonitorEndpoints
methods.description: Returns the current list of endpoints.

methods.name: TestConnectivity::checkCurlResponse
methods.description: Performs curl-based connectivity checks across multiple endpoints with timeout and interface options.

methods.name: TestConnectivity::getInternetState
methods.description: Determines internet connectivity state based on curl responses.

methods.name: ConnectivityMonitor::getInternetState
methods.description: Returns current internet status, performing connectivity check if needed.

methods.name: ConnectivityMonitor::getCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Returns the URI of the captive portal if detected.

methods.name: ConnectivityMonitor::notifyInternetStatusChangedEvent
methods.description: Notifies the system of a change in internet status.

methods.name: ConnectivityMonitor::connectivityMonitorFunction
methods.description: Main loop for periodic connectivity checking and status notification.
